Score in C (Concert Pitch). All instruments sound as written except standard octave transpositions: - Piccolo sounds 8va higher - Contrabass and Contrabassoon sound 8vb lower
Performance Instructions: - Strings: Molto espressivo e legato unless marked otherwise. - Brass: Observe dynamic balance in tutti sections. - Woodwinds: Adhere strictly to phrase and breath marks.
